title: Democratic Impact Monitor: Food Integrity Agricultural MSP and Nutrition Guarantee Bill
objective: Track MSP realization, food adulteration reduction, and nutritional security.

indicators.name: MSP Realization Percentage
indicators.definition: Proportion of agricultural produce sold at or above statutory C2+50% MSP.
indicators.independent_validation: Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices Audit

oversight.body: National Agricultural Price and Food Integrity Board
oversight.composition: Farmer representatives, agricultural economists, food scientists

complaints.channel: Farmer MSP Grievance Portal & Mandi Ombudsman

triggers.condition: Mandi trade price falling below statutory MSP for any crop in a district.
triggers.interim_protection: Mandatory market intervention and state procurement
